title_zh: 经济学家如何看中国经济
note_en: 并不 is a stronger, more formal "not" that pushes back against an assumption: 意见并不完全一致 "opinions are by no means in full agreement." Where plain 不 simply negates, 并不 implies "contrary to what you might expect," much like English "not actually" or "by no means," which is why it is common in analytical writing.
